name: Sinusbot
description: SinusBot is a MusicBot that will let you listen to music together with your friends on either TeamSpeak 3 or Discord. But it doesn't stop there - there's a lot of user-made scripts that can let SinusBot manage your Server and enhance the experience of your users in several ways. You and your friends can control the bot either through the included web interface or via commands through TeamSpeak 3 or Discord. *** Login *** User: admin Password: (your password from WEB UI Password)
